archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Precision) blended with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST for a raw, industrial workshop feel.

editorial_accents.style: italic, refined, used for quotes and manifesto text

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the entire page to give it a gritty, oily, garage feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders separating sections and bento grids, representing an industrial/blueprint aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: No soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders and high contrast backgrounds. Cards should be flat dark grey (#121212) with a 1px border (#27272A).

layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Massive typography with line-by-line reveal using clip-path. Parallax background image of a motorcycle, heavily masked with a linear gradient so it fades into black at the bottom.
layouts.services_grid: Mode A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid. Asymmetrical grid for services. Mix of col-span-2 and col-span-1. Hovering over a service card changes the border color to accent rust.
layouts.gallery: Grid layout with clipped frames. Images must use object-cover. Hovering images triggers a slow scale effect (scale-105) over 0.6s.
layouts.manifesto: Split layout. Left side: Massive numbers (01, 02) in outline or Bebas Neue. Right side: Elegant typography in Cormorant Garamond telling the story.

motion.global: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveal. `initial={{ y: '100%' }}` and `animate={{ y: 0 }}` with a parent container having `overflow: hidden`. Staggered delays.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee. Editorial Ribbon style. Slow drift, monospace or uppercase Bebas Neue font, outlined or low opacity.
motion.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion `whileInView` for fade-up and subtle Y translation on sections.
motion.parallax: Framer motion useScroll and useTransform for parallaxing background images in the hero and gallery.

components.header: Fixed top, z-50. Glassmorphism: `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10`. Minimal navigation links, prominent CTA.
components.footer: Massive 'LOCAL MOTO' text at text-[15vw]. Huge py-32 padding. Darkest background (#050505).
components.forms: Shadcn UI base. Customized for industrial look: `bg-transparent border-white/20 rounded-none focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-0`. Use sharp edges, no rounded corners for inputs.

image_urls.description: Black bone motorcycle on black background. Use with heavy gradient overlay.
Grayscale photography of metal tools. Excellent for garage atmosphere.
Cruiser parked on concrete. Good contextual shot.

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus states (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent-primary focus-visible:outline-none`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use `bg-black/60` scrims on images with text over them.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: Bebas Neue, Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>`, `<input type='date'>` directly for advanced inputs. Use Shadcn components, but customize them heavily with sharp corners (rounded-none) and border-white/20.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in App.js or main layout component.
Ensure all major interactive elements have `data-testid` tags as per requirements.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. No universal transitions (`transition-all`). Target specific properties (`transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Do NOT center align the app container. Use optical left alignment.
Use Framer Motion to create the kinetic line-by-line reveal in the hero section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Component located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or sonner.jsx.
